title: Predicted Fgf10a–Fgfr2b complex (Boltz-2) with a non-cognate Fgfr2c control that scored higher: no specificity signal
evidence_kind: PREDICTED: a computed structure hypothesis, not an observed structure

model.name: Boltz-2 complex prediction, 3 samples each, PDB70 MSA per chain
model.context: Fgf10a core (Q8AY90 58-201) with Fgfr2 IIIb D2-D3 (F1RBT3 150-360); control: Fgfr2 IIIc D2-D3 (Q8JG38 150-362). IIIb chosen by alignment to human P21802-3 vs -1.

numerical_checks.name: cognate IIIb: confidence / pTM / interface pLDDT (top)
non-cognate IIIc control: confidence / pTM / interface pLDDT (top)
receptor interface residues inside the IIIb/IIIc alternative exon
closest PDB70 hit, receptor IIIb construct
numerical_checks.result: 3OJM_B at 78% identity over 99% of the query (121 hits total; ranked by identity x coverage)

numerical_checks.name: closest PDB70 hit, receptor IIIc control construct
numerical_checks.result: 1IIL_F at 81% identity over 99% of the query (121 hits total; ranked by identity x coverage)

numerical_checks.name: template proximity as the suspected cause of the control inversion
numerical_checks.result: the non-cognate IIIc construct has the CLOSER template of the two, which suggested template proximity rather than biology was tracking the scores - but the control below TESTS that and does not support it

numerical_checks.name: TEMPLATE CONTROL: both complexes refolded with a single-sequence MSA (no PDB70 alignment)
numerical_checks.result: cognate 0.767 -> 0.614, non-cognate 0.844 -> 0.66. The non-cognate complex still scores higher; the gap only narrows from 0.077 to 0.046. The inversion is NOT explained by template proximity.

numerical_checks.name: which chain the alignment was holding up
numerical_checks.result: The two chains behave very differently without an MSA. The Fgf10a ligand chain collapses (-47.8 and -35.4 mean pLDDT), while the Fgfr2 receptor chain barely moves (-11.2 and -0.7). The receptor's D2-D3 immunoglobulin fold is common in the training set, so the model reconstructs it from sequence alone; the ligand's confidence was alignment-dependent.

parameter_unknowns: Confidence scores are not affinities; no ddG was computed (stab_ddg needs an undocumented upload manifest, blocked).
open_questions: Would a deep (UniRef) MSA or AlphaFold3 discriminate IIIb from IIIc? Would MD separate them?
Why does the inversion survive removal of the MSA? A single-sequence input removes the alignment but not the model's learned structural memory, so memorisation is not excluded.
limitations: MSA is PDB70-only (structural database, 14-122 sequences), so homologous crystal structures may be templated.
The negative control failed to discriminate, so the predictor is not informative about isoform choice here.
The single-sequence control removes the MSA, not learned structural memory: the receptor chain still reaches above 80 pLDDT with no alignment.
does_not_establish: FGF10-FGFR2b isoform specificity (the non-cognate control scores higher)
that this complex forms in the zebrafish or flying-fish pectoral fin bud
